blocks.text: Scouts, tenders and sail arrays that help a fight.
Support ships help a fight without shooting. Passive abilities always work.
Use an active one with Q or its ship panel button.
Deep Sensors: Sees far, into spice nebulae and through ion storms.

Radiation Sail: Support ship for Radiation zones. The shield is a bubble that soaks fire and blocks Radiation for everything inside; touching bubbles merge into a Mega Shield. Disruptor shots pass through, and an Inhibitor hit knocks the bubble offline. Unarmed.
Radiation Sail Arrays whose bubbles touch share one Mega Shield.
